question: What is the meaning of component joints in relation to geometric information?
description: Component joints refer to the connections between different parts or elements within a building system, allowing for the transfer of forces and movement. In relation to geometric information, component joints would involve the precise measurements and angles necessary to ensure proper alignment and fit between the connected components. This geometric information is crucial for the structural integrity and functionality of the building system.
